title: Mighty Thai Meat Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Thai-inspired stew made with tender meat and a variety of spices. Perfect for a cold night!
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of mighty in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced croatian and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
